scenario.title: Reschedule an existing visit
scenario.situation: You believe you have a checkup next Wednesday at 9 but can no longer attend.
scenario.objective: Move it to a weekday afternoon if the existing visit can be found.
scenario.probes: If no matching visit exists, accept that and ask the correct next step; don't invent ID.
scenario.expected: Verifies identity and appointment; doesn't claim to move an unverified booking.

timestamp_note: Offsets from capture start; transcript times are turn commits, not word-aligned speech times. Audio timing uses frame arrival.
recap: No matching visit was found for my appointment, and the office cannot proceed further now. They offered to connect me to patient support for follow-up.
